name: Redeem and Roll Baseline
goal: Redeem the high-confidence codes, build one functional car, and record the upgrade costs shown in your server.
coinRule: Spend just enough cash to unlock steady income before buying every available crate.
risk: Opening all boxes instantly can leave you with rare parts but no cash path.

name: Cash Engine Upgrade
goal: Improve the car that earns money over time before building a flex-only showcase car.
coinRule: If an upgrade raises cash flow, it can pay for the next crate cycle.
risk: Rare-looking parts are not always the best first investment.

name: Crate Step-Up Check
goal: Move to better crates only when your current income can recover the cost of several missed rolls.
coinRule: Keep enough reserve for at least one garage or income upgrade after a crate session.
risk: A single expensive crate can delay garage expansion if it misses.

name: Garage Space Split
goal: Separate cash farming, rare-part showcase, and merge testing into different slots.
coinRule: Buy space when it prevents you from dismantling a working car.
risk: Too many half-built cars can slow progress more than one strong car.

name: Merge and Dealer Risk Control
goal: Use duplicates and spare cash for dealer or merge experiments while protecting your core builds.
coinRule: Never risk the part that keeps your best income build working.
risk: Testing every rumored combo without notes makes it hard to learn what worked.
